Distributions are not run while the vault holds less than the reserve plus a minimum amount (currently US$20), or while the coin has more eligible holders than the platform's current limit. Holder Rewards are therefore paid net of distribution costs and are not guaranteed; the eligibility rules are described in the Terms of Use and in the pump.fun public documentation.

children: A trade in a coin paired with another pump.fun coin may be routed through more than one pool (for example SOL to the pair coin, then the pair coin to the coin you are buying). On the pump.fun web app, mobile app and Terminal, the Protocol fee is charged once, on the first pool in the chain (the pool furthest from the coin you are trading), at that pool's rate and in that pool's quote asset; and the Creator fee (or Holder Rewards) and LP fee are charged once, on the last pool in the chain (the pool of the coin you are buying or selling), at that coin's rates and in the asset that coin is paired with. Trading interfaces that have not adopted the current pump.fun program may charge Protocol, Creator and LP fees on every pool in the route, so the total fee on such an interface can be a multiple of the rates above.

Cashback mode is no longer available for new launches. On an existing Cashback coin, the Creator fee is credited back to the buyer as cashback where the trading interface submits the trade using the cashback instructions, and is paid to the creator where it does not; accrued cashback can be claimed through the pump.fun app. A Cashback coin may be converted into a Holder Rewards coin through a CTO.

On transactions on EVM Blockchains (including Robinhood Chain), the pump.fun platform collects a fee of between 0.10% and 0.15% of the value of each transaction as part of the transaction, as described in Section 4.7 of the Terms of Use. This fee is charged in addition to the Platform Fee described under “Platform Fee” below and to the fees charged by the third-party bridge and swap provider that executes the transaction, which are not set by pump.fun. The amounts for your transaction are shown before you confirm it. The platform pays the network gas on these transactions. The pump.fun fee is set by the platform and may change.

Trades placed through the pump.fun web app or the pump.fun mobile app carry the Platform Fee described below in addition to the fees above. If you access the pump.fun platform or smart contracts via another interface or platform, the Platform Fee does not apply, but you may incur additional fees charged by those interfaces or platforms.
